dialogue.text: I know I can't take one more step towards you
dialogue.zh: 我知道我無法再向你邁出一步
dialogue.ja: もうこれ以上あなたに一歩も近づけないとわかっている
dialogue.local: I know I can't take one more step towards you
dialogue.en: I know I can't take one more step towards you

dialogue.text: Cause all that's waiting is regret
dialogue.zh: 因為等待我的只有後悔
dialogue.ja: 待っているのは後悔だけだから
dialogue.local: Cause all that's waiting is regret
dialogue.en: Cause all that's waiting is regret

dialogue.text: And don't you know I'm not your ghost anymore
dialogue.zh: 你難道不知道我不再是你的幽靈了嗎
dialogue.ja: もう私はあなたの亡霊じゃないって知らないの？
dialogue.local: And don't you know I'm not your ghost anymore
dialogue.en: And don't you know I'm not your ghost anymore

dialogue.text: You lost the love I loved the most
dialogue.zh: 你失去了我最愛的愛情
dialogue.ja: あなたは私が一番愛した愛を失った
dialogue.local: You lost the love I loved the most
dialogue.en: You lost the love I loved the most

dialogue.text: I learned to live half a life
dialogue.zh: 我學會了過著半生的生活
dialogue.ja: 私は半分の人生を生きることを学んだ
dialogue.local: I learned to live half a life
dialogue.en: I learned to live half a life

dialogue.text: And now you want me one more time
dialogue.zh: 而現在你想要我再給你一次機會
dialogue.ja: そして今、もう一度私を求めている
dialogue.local: And now you want me one more time
dialogue.en: And now you want me one more time

dialogue.text: And who do you think you are
dialogue.ja: 自分が誰だと思っているの？

dialogue.en: And who do you think you are

dialogue.text: And tearing love apart

dialogue.local: And tearing love apart
